title: Fluid administration in ketoacidosis
official: Comparison of isotonic saline and Ringer lactate in the management of severe diabetic ketoacidosis: a double-blind randomized controlled trial.
summary: Main objective: To compare fluid resuscitation with Ringer Lactate to isotonic saline on the resolution of diabetic ketoacidosis at 24 hours from randomization (i.e. start of the investigational medicinal product administration) in patients with severe diabetic ketoacidosis.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Admission to emergency department or direct admission to ICU
2. Diagnosis of severe diabetic ketoacidosis requiring all the following criteria: o Blood or capillary glucose > 11 mmol/L o Ketonemia or ketonuria > 0 o Venous or arterial pH < 7.30 or venous or arterial bicarbonate < 15 mmol/L
3. Volume of fluid administered before inclusion ≤1L
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients <18 ans
2. Pregnant women
3. Contraindication to isotonic saline or Ringer Lactate
4. Patients with a decision to withdraw life-sustaining therapy
